text: ここは　７のしま　おわりなく　はてしなき　もとめじま

patterns.name: 〜なく
patterns.explanation: なく after a thing means 'without it', and leads on to what comes next. おわりなく = 'without end'.

patterns.name: 〜き
patterns.span: はてしなき　もとめじま
patterns.explanation: き is an old, poetic form of the い ending, used right before the thing being described. はてしなき　もとめじま = 'the boundless Quest Island'.
